note: Image Link Formatter provides one image field formatter, id 'image_link_formatter' (label 'Image wrapped within link field'), for image fields. It extends core ImageFormatter via ImageLinkFormatterTrait and adds the entity/bundle's Link fields as options to the core 'image_link' (Link image to) setting; at render it wraps each image in the same-delta Link field's URL. Configured on core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>: content.<image_field>.type = image_link_formatter and settings.image_link = <link field machine name>. No configure route, no permission, no Drush, no config schema of its own; requires image + link. Submodule responsive_image_link_formatter does the same for responsive images. Medium cases read a live view display; hard cases set the formatter/link, verified against entity_view_display config. Fixtures create namespaced field_ilf_img (image) + field_ilf_link (link) on Article and delete them (scoped, by name) in cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: I want images in a field to be clickable, linking to a URL an editor enters in a separate Link field. With the Image Link Formatter module, which formatter do I choose for the image field and what is it called in the UI?
evals.expected_output: On the bundle's Manage display, set the image field's formatter to 'Image wrapped within link field' (plugin id image_link_formatter). In its settings, the 'Link image to' dropdown now lists the entity's Link fields; pick the one whose URL should wrap the image.

evals.prompt: Using image_link_formatter, which formatter setting selects the link field, and how are multiple images paired with multiple link values?
evals.expected_output: The core 'Link image to' setting (settings.image_link) is extended to accept a Link field machine name; select your link field there. Multiple values pair by delta: image delta 0 is wrapped by link delta 0, delta 1 by delta 1, and so on. An empty link item leaves that image unwrapped.

evals.prompt: What core modules does Image Link Formatter require, and does it respect link options like opening in a new tab (target=_blank) added by modules such as Link Attributes or Link Target?
evals.expected_output: It requires the core image and link modules. Yes - attributes set on the Link item (e.g. target="_blank", rel) via Link Attributes or Link Target are carried onto the image's link automatically, because the link's Url object retains them.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article content type has an image field 'field_ilf_img'. Inspect the live default view display for Article and state which field formatter is applied to that image field.
evals.expected_output: The formatter is image_link_formatter ('Image wrapped within link field'): in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ilf_img component has type image_link_formatter.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article image field 'field_ilf_img' is displayed with the Image Link Formatter. Inspect the live view display and tell me which Link field's URL is used to wrap the image.
evals.expected_output: The link field is field_ilf_link: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_ilf_img component's settings.image_link = field_ilf_link.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has an image field 'field_ilf_img' and a link field 'field_ilf_link'. On the default view display, the image currently uses the core image formatter. Using the Image Link Formatter module, change the image field so it renders wrapped in the link from field_ilf_link. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set field_ilf_img component type to image_link_formatter with settings.image_link = field_ilf_link, then save. Verify checks type === image_link_formatter and settings.image_link === field_ilf_link.

evals.prompt: On the Article display for this site, the images in the 'field_ilf_img' field are shown with the Image Link Formatter but they aren't clickable - they don't link anywhere. There is a link field 'field_ilf_link' on the same content. Make the images link to the URL from that link field. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set the field_ilf_img component's settings.image_link to field_ilf_link (keeping type image_link_formatter) on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default and save. Verify checks type === image_link_formatter and settings.image_link === field_ilf_link.
